name: Aqua (EOS PM-1)

source.publisher: NASA — https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/aqua-b/ (credit: NASA/Brian E. Kumanchik; NASA/Christian A. Lopez; uploaded 2025-03-21); mirrored at https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources under '3D Models/Aqua (B)' (repo README: assets are free and without copyright)

identity.satcat: CelesTrak SATCAT retrieved 2026-07-16: AQUA = 2002-022A / 27424, on orbit, operational status '+'. NASA publishes this asset as the Aqua mission model; the mesh carries Aqua's published configuration (gold MLI bus, single long deployed solar array, AMSR-E dish at the bus end).

processing.method: KHR_draco_mesh_compression decoded offline via scripts/earthtwin_glb_decompress.mjs (gltf-transform + draco3dgltf; also restores the spec PNG fallback `source` on EXT_texture_webp textures — the PNG twins ship inside the NASA GLB); then vertex-cluster decimation (grid 384, material+normal-octant keyed); per-vertex colors sampled from the real base-color textures (nearest texel at each vertex UV × baseColorFactor) — derived from the NASA asset, nothing invented

honesty: Decimated derivative of NASA's official Aqua model for focused-object display (72–480 px with zoom-to-inspect). Geometry and colors are simplified from the source asset; this is a real model of the real satellite, not a class-representative form.
